mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm FROM WELFARE ORDER BY WELFARE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT w.WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, w.LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(w.FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(w.FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(w.FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm, COUNT(wi.WELFARE_ID) AS wishCount FROM WELFARE w LEFT JOIN WISH wi ON w.WELFARE_ID = wi.WELFARE_ID GROUP BY w.WELFARE_ID, w.LCLSF_NM, JSON_VALUE(w.FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm'), JSON_VALUE(w.FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd'), JSON_VALUE(w.FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') ORDER BY wishCount DESC, w.WELFARE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.lastMdfcnDt') AS lastMdfcnDt, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprtTrgtMinAge') AS sprtTrgtMinAge, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprtTrgtMaxAge') AS sprtTrgtMaxAge, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.ptcpPrpTrgtCn') AS ptcpPrpTrgtCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.earnEtcCn') AS earnEtcCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcySprtCn') AS plcySprtCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyAplyMthdCn') AS plcyAplyMthdCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.srngMthdCn') AS srngMthdCn, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyUrlAddr') AS aplyUrlAddr, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyExplnCn') AS plcyExplnCn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISH WHERE WELFARE_ID = #{id}) AS wishCount FROM WELFARE WHERE WELFARE_ID = #{id}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WELFARE_ID AS welfareId, LCLSF_NM AS lclsfNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.plcyNm') AS plcyNm, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.aplyYmd') AS aplyYmd, JSON_VALUE(FULL_DATA, '$.sprvsnInstCdNm') AS sprvsnInstCdNm FROM WELFARE WHERE LCLSF_NM LIKE '%' || #{lclsfNm} || '%' AND WELFARE_ID != #{excludeId} ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
